model: RIBTW24B-BCAO BACnet relay with analog output
applies_to: Functional Devices RIBTW24B-BCAO BACnet MS/TP relay with one analog output, one analog input and one binary input.
summary: A BACnet MS/TP relay module with one relay (BO1), one analog output in percent (AO1), one binary input and one analog input. All four objects are plain I/O; there is no on-board control logic.
firmware: Firmware 2.04, application 1.5 (the device object table prints 1.3)
notes: Object names are user-writable and the PICS prints no factory default name, so each object is listed by its printed ID (BI1, BO1...).
The PICS prints the AO identifier as "A01"; it is Analog Output 1.
AO1 and BO1 have 16-level priority arrays; AO1 is fixed at 0-100 %.

integration.summary: Write BO1 for the relay and AO1 for the 0-100 % output; read BI1 and AI1.
setup: The PICS prints the device object ID default as DE277000 (vendor ID 277); it is writable.
MS/TP master; baud rates are listed in the PICS. Max_Master defaults to 127.

points.name: AI1
points.description: Analog input: 0-5/0-10 Vdc or 10K T2/T3 thermistor
